findings: `learner.overview.text` presents the proposed sound similarity between 找 and 抓 as “similar proposed Old Chinese forms,” but its citations also support the specific same-system Zhengzhang comparison: 找 *ʔsruːʔ and 抓 *ʔsruːʔ. State that concrete comparison, while retaining that borrowing is unproven, so the learner layer explains the proposed mechanism without obscuring its evidence (`X-9bf672cd64196b15fe77`, `X-be11b23c7bf909bb5490`).
